user.title: Choose your UPS
user.description: Only UPS units seen by a Bluetooth adapter or proxy are listed. Disconnect any phone from the UPS first: it accepts only one Bluetooth connection at a time.

bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up {name}? Home Assistant will keep the UPS's only Bluetooth connection while the integration is running.

enable_active.title: Bluetooth needs active scanning
enable_active.description:
The UPS wasn't found. Your Bluetooth adapter **{adapters}** listens passively, and in that mode it can't see the UPS.

Switch it to **active** scanning? This is the same as Settings → Connectivity → Bluetooth → adapter → ⚙ → *Active*. You can change it back there any time. Bluetooth proxies (ESPHome etc.) are not changed.

To cancel, close this dialog.
enable_active.submit: Switch to active and search again

battery_setup.title: Your battery
battery_setup.description: {name} answered. Tell us about the battery connected to it so Home Assistant can show the estimated runtime. You can change this later under Configure.

data_description.battery_capacity_ah: From the battery label, e.g. 30 Ah. Leave 0 to skip the runtime estimate.
data_description.typical_load_w: Power drawn by your devices, if you know it. Used until the UPS measures the real load during the next power outage. 0 = wait for an outage.

error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant sees the UPS but the connection failed twice ({error}). Usually a previous connection is still held: restart Home Assistant (this also clears a connection left over from a removed integration), make sure no phone or other app is connected, then try again.
error.not_reachable: No Bluetooth adapter or proxy that can make connections currently sees the UPS. Wait a minute for it to advertise again (it stops while something is connected to it), or move a Bluetooth proxy closer.
error.not_supported: The device answered, but not like a BestEn SC-160 UPS ({error}). Pick a different device.

abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not a supported UPS.
abort.no_devices_found_active: Bluetooth is now in active scanning mode, but the UPS still was not seen. Disconnect any phone or app from it, check it is within range of the adapter (metal racks block Bluetooth), and try again in a minute.
abort.no_devices_found: No BestEn SC-160 UPS seen over Bluetooth. A UPS stops advertising while a phone, PC app or other tool is connected to it: disconnect it, wait about a minute, and try again. Also check that a Bluetooth adapter or proxy is in range (Settings → Bluetooth → Advertisement monitor: look for a device with service FFE0).

init.title: Options
init.description: Describe the battery connected to the UPS so the integration can estimate the runtime.

data_description.battery_capacity_ah: From the battery label, e.g. 30 Ah. Set 0 to turn off the runtime estimate.
data_description.battery_bms: Only matters for LiFePO4. Without a BMS the estimate is more conservative.
data_description.typical_load_w: Power drawn by your devices, used for the runtime estimate until the UPS measures it during the next power outage (it can only measure the load on battery). 0 = wait for an outage.

battery.title: Battery details
battery.description: Rated energy: {rated_wh} Wh. With the suggested values about {usable_wh} Wh is usable before the UPS cuts off (suggested usable share for this battery: {default_pct} %).

data_description.battery_voltage: 12.8 V for a 4-cell LiFePO4, 12 V for lead-acid (AGM/GEL).
data_description.battery_usable_pct: Lower it for an old battery or a cold location.
